_doc: Bootstrap pointer for store_id=palmetto (Austin). Legal entity, display name, and employee roster live in BQ / gitignored config — not in git. Consumed by BHAGA orchestrator and skills.
_doc_google_account_key: Matches the key in core/config.yaml accounts.{key}. Determines which Google credentials refresh_access_token() uses.

timezone._doc: Square account display TZ is Central (same as shop). Verified 2026-06-23: prod BQ timestamps are in CDT (-05:00), confirming the dashboard exports in Central time. ADP times are already shop-local (no conversion needed).

shop_hours._doc: Used by the orchestrator to schedule the daily refresh AFTER all clock-outs. Refresh fires at close + ORCHESTRATOR_SCRAPE_BUFFER_MINUTES_AFTER_SHOP_CLOSE (60 min) -> 22:00 CT.

bhaga_model._doc_labor_daily_forecast_retired: The labor_daily_forecast tab was retired 2026-06-09. Forecast data is now BQ-authoritative via model_forecast_daily + forecast_bq.py. Grafana is the review surface.
bhaga_model._doc_training_shifts: HUMAN-OWNED tip exemptions (table name retained). Columns: employee_name (canonical 'Last, First') | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | exempt_start/exempt_end (nullable HH:MM America/Chicago; both NULL = whole-day exemption) | note. Whole-day or window subtracts tip-eligible hours only (labor% unaffected). Orphan windows (no ADP shift yet) are stored and apply when the shift appears. Primary edit path: Operator Console Payroll Tip Exemptions (open period). Slack training set/rm writes whole-day NULL times.

bhaga_review_raw._doc: Per-review audit trail populated by process_reviews.py. Source data for the review_bonus_period rollup tab on bhaga_model.

clickup._doc: Source channel where the upstream Google-review automation posts each new review. Read by skills/clickup_chat via PAT in Keychain.

square._doc_location_id: Square location ID for the Austin Mueller Lake store (confirmed 2026-06-23 via GET /v2/locations).
square._doc: OAuth access via Square REST API. Tokens in Secret Manager secret square_palmetto_oauth. Operator account email is not stored in git.

adp_run._doc: wage_rate_report_name is the saved custom report under Reports > My saved custom reports. compensation_backend uses this to find the right report row to click.

employees._doc: Roster, aliases, and tip/labor exclusions live in BQ (employee_aliases, store_config). Do not commit real names here — kept empty as bootstrap only.
employees._doc_exclusions: Permanent tip/labor exclusions are configured in BQ store_config, not in this JSON.

labor_config._doc: Store-specific seed default (~4 orders/hourly-labor-hour). Operator can override in-sheet; subsequent refreshes preserve the in-sheet value.
labor_config._doc_forecast_target_completion_time_per: Flat, configurable staffing-solver target (seconds per item) — 420 = 7 min/item. Drives forecast efficiency_hours and the operational kds_pct_items_over_goal threshold. Editable in-sheet (config tab) AND per forecast row (labor_daily_forecast.target_time_per_item_sec). NOT derived from observed KDS — observed KDS time is purely operational/observational and never feeds the solver.

calibration.verified_by: Cursor AI agent via user-playwright MCP + Google API direct.

first_data_window._doc: Initial historical backfill window. After this is loaded and validated, the orchestrator switches to T-1 daily increments.

notes: Square / ADP / Sheets calibration completed 2026-05-16. Per-employee and wage details are not recorded in git — see BQ / private ops notes.
